sponsor_or_proposer: Venture Global LNG (US LNG supplier); Aktor LNG / Aktor LNG USA (Greek group, regional trading/logistics); Albgaz (Albanian state gas operator)
current_state: MOU / 20-year, ~1 bcm/yr, ~USD 6bn supply deal signed late Apr 2026. Near-term gas reaches Albania via Greece's Revythousa terminal + TAP; the deal envisages STUDIES on building permanent LNG regasification infrastructure at the Port of Vlora plus converting the idle Vlora oil-fired power plant to gas. Targeted operation ~2030; terminal is pre-construction (no FID, no construction).
missing_threshold_elements: No terminal FID or construction start; the regasification terminal is at MOU/study stage only. Terminal design is UNCONFIRMED: Tirana Examiner frames it as permanent onshore regasification, while LNG Prime and Serbia-Energy describe an FSRU-based import scheme — the MOU itself only commits to a feasibility study, so onshore-vs-floating is open. Distinct from GEM's dormant Excelerate Port of Vlora FSRU unit (G100002092400) — same physical site, different corporate principals.
watch_for: Terminal FID; construction start at Port of Vlora; confirmation of onshore vs floating design; whether the Vlora power-plant conversion and Fier-Vlora pipeline advance; whether GEM opens a NEW unit/terminal for this (dead-and-revived under different sponsor/design per lifecycle_rules.md = a new record, not a revival of G100002092400).
